page.overview:
Who is Breas?

Breas, called "The Bear-Hearted," is a Wood Elf charioteer of the Kindred of Equos.

He is reputed to live amongst a group of wild cave bears, where the Meadow Glades meets the foothills of the Grey Mountains. He can trace his lineage to Chrace and Avelorn in the High Elven kingdoms of Ulthuan and often wears an Elven helm of forest green which is an heirloom of his Avelorn kin.

Though relatively short for an Elf, Breas is said to have a heart as big as his bears and is so named the "Bear-hearted." Breas is particularly nimble even for his own kind and in the heat of battle will be seen running up the yoke of his chariots while it thunders across the Wild Heath. Breas directs his chariot by communicating with the bears that draw it in a series of low growls and grunts. Breas' bears, Cromm and Cruach, are his constant companions and he rides with two of his strange and silent kin folk who hurl javelins at their foes.
